Hero.subtitle: Moderation, leveling, tickets, mini-games and more. Everything you need in a single bot.

moderation.title: Moderation
moderation.description: Warnings, bans, automod, timeout, kick, clear — everything to keep your server clean.

leveling.title: Leveling
leveling.description: Full XP system with ranks, leaderboards and tiered rewards.

tickets.title: Tickets
tickets.description: Private support in two clicks with dropdown menus and auto-close.

games.title: Mini-games
games.description: Tic-Tac-Toe, Simon, Hangman — engage your community with built-in games.

birthdays.title: Birthdays
birthdays.description: The bot automatically wishes your members a happy birthday.

announcements.title: Announcements
announcements.description: Role-targeted pings (mail, recruitment, giveaways, partnerships, events…).

invite.title: Invite Neko
invite.description: Add the bot to your server in one click.

signin.title: Sign in
signin.description: Log in with Discord on the dashboard.

configure.title: Configure
configure.description: Enable and tune each module your way.

Dashboard.title: Dashboard
Dashboard.serverErrorHint: Loading failed (Discord may be temporarily unavailable). Try again in a moment.
Dashboard.resetConfigHint: Disables all modules and clears configured channels/roles. Member levels and warnings are kept.
Dashboard.deleteHint: Permanently deletes the server row AND every member's levels/warnings (cascade).
Dashboard.serversSubtitle: Pick a server to configure, or invite Neko where it's missing.
Dashboard.noServers: No server where you are an administrator.
Dashboard.loadError: Couldn't load your servers. Sign in again and retry.
Dashboard.noBotToken: Channel/role pickers are unavailable (bot token not configured on the site). Enter Discord IDs manually for now.
